title: FitnessGram Pacer Test
blurb: The FitnessGram Pacer Test is a multi-stage aerobic capacity test that progressively gets more difficult as it continues — and an entire generation of American schoolchildren can recite that opening verbatim while feeling their lungs preemptively tighten. The narration is delivered with the calm of an automated safety announcement, which somehow made it worse. It became a meme because the trauma was genuinely universal: same gymnasium, same tape, same beep gradually speeding up, same handful of children still running long after everyone else sat down. Do not stop. Do not slow down.
origin: The narration from the school FitnessGram Pacer Test.
